provider.costRule: This table is a planning guide. Ask the provider for the live cost before every generation; the live cost wins.

routing.model: none: HTML/SVG or a research-grounded visual skill

rules: The brief states the budget. No budget, no spend: return a plan with the credits it would need.
Three first-round directions, one draft each. At most two one-variable refinements on one direction, then stop.
Report credits spent and the remaining balance in every hand-off.

staging.record: asset.json beside the files: job, placement, model, prompt, creation id, credits, rights note, alt intent, scores, lifecycle
staging.rule: Download into staging; never hotlink a generation URL. Staging is the producer's only write area besides its memory.

releaseBar.ship: no 0s, average at least 2.2, provenance at least 2, asset record complete

never: Uploading local files to a provider without the owner's approval
A real person's likeness, a third-party mark, or a copyrighted character
Publishing or moving files out of staging into a product repository
